newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-IMSA started as accumulate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-IMSA started as accumulate.

text.p: Merrill Lynch initiated coverage of Mexican steelmaker Grupo Imsa with a rating of D-2-2-9, analyst Francisco Martins wrote in a report dated March 13.

--The "D" code refers to a high country risk, and the following codes refer to short-term (less than 12 months) and long-term (greater than one year) appreciation potential rating of accumulate, and the fact the company has as yet no dividend policy.

--Martins wrote "The rating reflects the company's favorable profit margins which we expect to widen further in 1998 as higher production capacities come on line, coupled with premium valuation relative to its Mexican counterparts in the steel industry."
